content: If you are in the United States or Canada and experience side effects from a medication, it is essential to contact your doctor for medical advice. In cases of overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. For less urgent situations, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Instead, ensure proper disposal of the product when it is expired or no longer needed. The information provided here is a summary and does not include all possible details about the product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about the product and your individual health requirements. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this medication with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Note that individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most current details, contact the applicable plan provider. If you are sending information about this offer to a recipient, they will receive further details and instructions on how to access it.
